name: Seasonal channels derived from the DEM
note: Flow lines computed from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (D8 routing). class main = upstream area >= 1,000 km2, primary = >= 100 km2. These are terrain-derived flow paths, not surveyed watercourses. Upstream areas count only the 2 x 2 degree DEM window, so flows entering from further north are not included: treat flood peaks on the main channels as unknown and declare what you assume.
